How to find the process that holds a file open

Open a command prompt and run tasklist. It prints a table like this one:

Image Name                     PID Session Name        Session#    Mem Usage
========================= ======== ================ =========== ============
notepad.exe                   4242 Console                    1     12,345 K

Look for the program by its image name and note the PID in the second
column. Pass that number to taskkill /PID to end it, or run tasklist /svc
to see which services a svchost.exe process hosts:

Image Name                     PID Services
========================= ======== ============================================
svchost.exe                   1100 RpcEptMapper, RpcSs

The Mem Usage column is the working set in kilobytes.
